- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
 Dated this the 27th day of August, 2014
JUDGMENT Ashok Bhushan, Ag.C.J. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned Government Pleader.

No notice is being issued to respondent Nos.1 and 2, in view of the order which is being passed.
2.
Petitioners claim to be the wholesale Raw Fish merchants doing business in Sakthanthampuran Non Vegetarian Public Market at Thrissur.
It has been further submitted that there is a dispute with regard to the retailers, and petitioners have already filed W.P.(C) No.16803 of 2014 before this Court regarding the same, which is pending.
Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that notice for agitation with effect from 28.08.2014 has been given by respondents 1 and 2.
He submits that in the event petitioners are unable to do the business, that shall cause great loss.

3. Learned Government Pleader submits that petitioners have not impleaded the Municipality which is controlling the market and further, in so far as the inter se dispute between the petitioners and retailers, the matter is pending consideration in another writ petition.

4. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, we are of the view that in so far as the inter se dispute between the petitioners and retailers is concerned, that cannot be entertained in this writ petition, since the petitioners have already filed another writ petition which is pending.
As far as the proposed agitation dated 28.08.2014 is concerned, it is for the Police to ensure that no law and order situation arises in the area due to the agitation.
It is submitted that petitioners have already informed the Police about the agitation as evidenced by Exhibits P3 to P5.

In the above view of the matter, we dispose of the writ petition with the observation that Police shall ensure that no law and order situation arises in the area due to the proposed agitation dated 28.08.2014.
Ashok Bhushan, Acting Chief Justice.
A.M. Shaffique, Judge.
